title: Bounded run of the advancing writer
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ and $w$ be finite words over a symbol type, and let $i$ be one of the $k$ work-tape indices. For a configuration $d$ on input $x$ whose states are indexed by the natural numbers from $0$ through the length of $w$, suppose its state is $0$. Then, for every natural number $r$ at most the length of $w$, running the machine that writes $w$ on tape $i$ for $r$ steps from $d$ gives the configuration specified by the advancing scan construction at parameter $r$.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $d$ on input $x$ with states indexed by $0$ through the length of $w$
